local_changes: Fix ucode two-argument index API misuse causing infinite tuple growth and OOM
Bound each connection to original/reply tuples, with monotonically advancing cursor and direction-local counters
Use seek/read for DNS log offsets and bound each read to 64 KiB
Rotate fully consumed default RAM DNS log after 1 MiB; preserve latest 1000 archived rows, refuse symlinks/custom paths
Mount zoneinfo into dnsmasq jail so native DNS log times match the router and collector
First boot initializes missing DNS query-log settings only when collection is enabled; preserve existing choices and run the existing duplicate-log guard
Retain bounded original/reply parser with actual ucode two-argument index suffix searches, including whitespace and direction-local counters
Merge bounded tmpfs snapshot/ring/history and nlbwmon per-MAC fallback; explicit nlbwmon package dependency
Discover all active default-route L3 WAN devices through netifd, deduplicate IPv6 aliases, sum both PPPoE links in backend and browser
Do not automatically install a bridge nft counter hook; aggregate uses port counters; its LAN residual is not an exact layer-2 byte measurement
Keep compact 220px chart and resize/hover behaviour
Do not install unrelated apk signing key automatically
Return from init before launching a disabled service

feed_services: Default inactive, checked in staged rootfs
npu_policy: Retain existing guarded binding path; extra UI is not a replacement driver
